# `aitbc system check`

Check AITBC systemd service health and active wallet balance.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system check [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | no | Check a specific systemd service |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system check
aitbc system check --output json
```
